title: 10-year-old Indigenous girl found dead, tied to tree in Maguindanao

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A 10-year-old Indigenous girl was found dead, naked, with her hands and feet bound and tied to a tree in a remote village in South Upi, Maguindanao del Sur, police said Tuesday. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), identified the victim only as alias “Cyll,” a Grade 5 pupil and resident of the said town. The victim was discovered at around 11 a.m. on Monday in Sitio Lower Tambel, Barangay Romongaob.
